name: AMMONIACUM GUMMI
key_symptoms: Catarrhal headache due to closure of frontal sinuses.

Difficult breathing. Chronic bronchial catarrh. Large accumulation of purulent matter and feeble expectoration; worse cold weather. Mucus tough and hard. Heart beats stronger, extends to pit of stomach. Coarse rattling of chest in old people.
